scope: Prepare the existing positive F02 ZIP-only replay; no codec, product imports, bootstrap invocation, host qualification or changed semantic expectation.

interface.roots: Explicit absolute existing roots; output absolute new directory. No hardcoded private paths.
interface.held_identities: Closed canonical object: schema=quorum/public-held-identities/1; bootstrap_entry,decoder_install_descriptor,runtime_descriptor,source_manifest,bundle_snapshot are exact {bytes,sha256} independently held pins, not derived expected trust from candidate files.
interface.fixture_manifest: Closed canonical object schema=quorum/public-replay-fixture/1, identity=STS1:<64 lowercase hex>, body,originals,expected,archive,share each exact {path,bytes,sha256}; relative paths confined to manifest parent. Fixed F02 pins, no new encoding.

preparation: Verify held bootstrap/INSTALL/RUNTIME/SOURCE/snapshot raw bytes, snapshot selected-root identity and every bounded snapshot file identity/mode, fixed 16 checker/helper files and canonical bounded fixture. Derive new local descriptor/Request/envelope/invocation canonical bytes mechanically. Deep-copy candidate keys; compare canonical host-root observations before and after preparation. Source tuple metadata comes from Body.sources and matching frozen originals metadata; no base64 decoding or original sidecar writes.
runtime_boundary: Transport invocation Body and original paths point into a nonexistent directory. Only actual ZIP/share, held pins, Request/envelope and declared roots are supplied to bootstrap. Body metadata read during preparation forms annotations; actual bootstrap Body/original bytes must come solely from ZIP.
output: Create-only descriptor,request,envelope,invocation,expected,result-command.json,command.txt,preparation-receipt.json. Command is not executed. expected changes only $mechanical Request pin. Trusted recipient verifies bootstrap entry bytes before execution; self-check is defense only.
remaining: No acceptance is produced by preparer. Actual bootstrap qualification, normal/-O replay, ZIP-only absence control and exact full result comparison remain required after owner review.
